edges.reason: sendValue forwards all remaining gas to the recipient through a low-level call, enabling reentrant execution.
recipient parameter flows into the value transfer in sendValue.
amount parameter controls the wei value sent by sendValue.
isContract executes the extcodehash assembly block.
codehash local receives the extcodehash result inside isContract.
transfer calls _callTokensToSend before balances are updated.
_callTokensToSend executes an external hook on an arbitrary registered implementer.
_mint calls _callTokensReceived after updating state.
_callTokensReceived executes an external hook on an arbitrary registered recipient.
SkaleToken overrides _callTokensToSend with the nonReentrant guard.
SkaleToken overrides _callTokensReceived with the nonReentrant guard.
The external mint call ultimately executes the internal _mint logic.
getBounty pays the bounty through the minting path.
nodeIndex parameter determines which node bounty is computed.
bounty local is derived and returned by getBounty.
getBounty authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with the node owner.
adjustPrice writes the recomputed value into price.
adjustPrice stores the current timestamp in lastUpdated.
loadDiff local participates in the price change computation.
priceChange local is applied to the current price.
adjustPrice relies on the miner-influenced block timestamp for cooldown and elapsed time.
getCurrentMonth derives the month directly from the block timestamp.
initialize grants the admin role to the caller-supplied msg.sender.
Initialization sets ownership state from the caller identity.
slash is restricted by the allow modifier that checks msg.sender against the contract registry.
delegate uses msg.sender as the token holder for the delegation.
createNode validates node ownership against msg.sender.
broadcast verifies that msg.sender owns the node index.
setContractsAddress is guarded by onlyOwner which compares against msg.sender.
The onlyOwner modifier reads the stored owner to authorize the caller.
validatorId parameter selects the validator to slash.
amount parameter defines the slashed token quantity.
Slashes are routed through the Punisher lock accounting.
_beforeTokenTransfer reads locked amounts to restrict transfers.
transfer triggers the before-transfer hook that reads locker state.
retrieve forwards the approved value into the token transfer call.
retrieve authorizes the transfer using the caller-supplied msg.sender approval entry.
retrieve locks the transferred amount via TokenLaunchLocker.
lock increases the locked balance tracked for the holder.
_getStageReward performs unchecked divisions and pool arithmetic that can overflow or lose precision.
withdrawBounty performs an external ERC20 transfer of the earned amount.
_mint credits the recipient balance mapping.
_mint increases the total supply state variable.
implementer local resolves the registered ERC1820 sender implementer used by _callTokensToSend.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter is only meaningful as an argument of Address.sendValue.
The amount parameter is only meaningful as an argument of Address.sendValue.
codehash is a scratch local used solely by Address.isContract.
loadDiff is a computation local inside Pricing.adjustPrice.
bounty is the returned computation local of SkaleManager.getBounty.
nodeIndex is the input parameter that drives SkaleManager.getBounty.
amount parameterizes the tokens confiscated by Punisher.slash.
priceChange is an intermediate local of Pricing.adjustPrice.
implementer is a local resolved inside ERC777._callTokensToSend before the external hook.
